steps: 1. Enroll in a free online course on active learning strategies to enhance your ability to learn new medical procedures.
2. Start a beginner language course in Amharic or Arabic using apps like Duolingo to improve communication with diverse patients.
3. Take a workshop or online module on athletic taping and training room maintenance to build hands-on clinical skills.
4. Shadow a Medical Assistant or Nurse for a day to observe patient care and clinical workflows.
5. Complete a certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) program to gain foundational patient care skills and clinical experience.
